headline_results.quote: Across a 32-loop adversarial red-team gauntlet encompassing 28 distinct attack classes, V30.1 achieves 96%–99% defense efficacy
enforcing a strict sleeper floor of Deff ≤ 0.0004 (4 × 10−4). This catches both +0.001 distributed sleeper poisoning and sorted-W1-preserving weight-shuffling permutations.
